title: The 10 Best Digital Multimeters
subtitle: Handheld multimeters for home electrical, automotive and electronics troubleshooting, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A digital multimeter measures voltage, current, resistance and continuity, the basics of finding a dead outlet, a bad fuse, a drained car battery or a broken wire. We ranked 10 best-sellers on rating, review volume and features (a stated CAT III or higher safety rating, True RMS, auto-ranging and non-contact voltage detection). If you'll test household wiring or panels, the CAT rating matters most: it tells you the meter is built to survive voltage spikes on mains circuits. They run from about $14 for KAIWEETS' basic meter to $144 for Fluke's 17B+.

avoid.verdict: A $10 meter whose listing describes multimeters in general rather than this one. The KAIWEETS is $4 more with a CAT III 600V rating and 25,214 reviews.
reasons: The bullets describe what multimeters do in general ('Multimetro typically have two probes...') and never give this meter's ranges, accuracy or count.
It lists no CAT safety rating, so there's no assurance it's built for mains voltage, which is exactly where a cheap meter can fail dangerously.
For $4 more, the KAIWEETS is CAT III 600V rated with a case, double fuses and nine times the reviews.

buyers_guide.q: What does the CAT rating mean?
buyers_guide.a: CAT ratings say where a meter can safely be used: CAT II for plug-in appliances, CAT III for household wiring and panels, CAT IV for the service entrance. A CAT III-rated meter is built to withstand voltage spikes that can make an unrated meter fail violently. Unrated meters are fine for batteries and electronics, not mains.
True RMS reads accurately on distorted AC waveforms from dimmers, motors and electronics. For basic household voltage and car work, an average-responding meter is fine.
Auto-ranging picks the range for you, which is faster and easier for beginners. Manual ranging is cheaper and can be faster once you know what you're measuring.

buyers_guide.q: What does non-contact voltage detection do?
buyers_guide.a: NCV beeps and lights near a live wire without touching it, a quick safety check before you work on a circuit. Always confirm with a proper measurement too.

buyers_guide.q: How do I test a car battery?
buyers_guide.a: Set DC volts, red lead to positive, black to negative. About 12.6 V is fully charged with the engine off; 13.7-14.7 V with it running means the alternator is charging.
